description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for handling email subscription entities within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for retrieving, counting, and saving email notification subscriptions, with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing email notification subscriptions, providing methods to retrieve, count, and save email subscription entities, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EmailNotification entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Provides a Paginator object for paginated retrieval of email subscriptions based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscriptions matching specific filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Retrieves a single EmailNotification entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists an EmailNotification entity to the database.
